name: 螺女
caveat: Shell+tail+human upper body/fins with retracting defense. No COD1 shelled humanoid. Bixi is a four-legged heavy turtle/stele, water ghost lacks shell, normal human rig lacks tail/shell; do not mix their budgets or choose a large turtle.

name: 飞蝗群
caveat: One entity containing14 separately winged insect bodies in current model. No COD1 comparable aggregate flying swarm. Centipede is one long segmented body, spider/scorpion terrestrial single arthropods, paper palanquin is a vehicle/carrier complex; none defines a defensible matching geometry budget.
